name: Wanderframe
summary: A frosted-glass creator studio for a travel video channel, over a drawn live wallpaper
about: Wanderframe is a studio app for a made-up travel channel. Frosted glass panels float over a hand-drawn landscape with drifting clouds that turns to a starry night in the dark theme. A live counter rolls up new subscribers, and the app covers content, a drag-and-drop upload calendar, analytics, audience, comments and sponsor deals.
how: Watch the subscriber counter roll and the last-hour views move on Studio
Open a video for its retention curve and traffic sources, then edit or publish it
Drag a planned video to another day on the calendar, or schedule an idea
Switch metrics and ranges on Analytics and watch the chart morph
Reply to, heart, pin or remove comments
Pick a different wallpaper scene in Settings and switch to the night theme
